sentences.en: The basin of a river usually has rich farmland.
sentences.zh: 一条河流的流域通常拥有肥沃的农田。

sentences.en: A student was run over by a car on Basin Street.
sentences.zh: 一名学生在盆地街被汽车撞倒了。

sentences.en: The Seine flows through the central part of the Paris Basin.
sentences.zh: 塞纳河穿过巴黎盆地的中心部分。

senses.zh: 盆地；盆；水池；流域 形容词: basinal
